description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Log' for logging purposes in an Android project. It provides static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a chain of LogNode objects for log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static logging methods and log node management for an Android application.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode in the chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a VERBOSE level message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG level message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an INFO level message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a WARN level message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an ERROR level message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an ASSERT level message, optionally with an exception.
